verdict.explanation: No actionable patch-introduced correctness defect was found in the scoped saved-density reference construction. The original internal-QE backend, physical Fourier mapping, ordinary-NC block Hamiltonian and longitudinal spin kernel are coherently connected, with executed original-fixture comparisons and completed actual-material output/readback evidence. Acceptance is of these constructed operators and stored diagnostics, not a stationary or calibrated material state or a completed coherence-domain model.

accepted_evidence.claim: The wrapper uses the original internal PBE archive, not Libxc or a rewritten PBE functional, and reproduces Native call order, layout, cutoffs and unit handling.
accepted_evidence.details: xc receives total density/magnetization; GGA and derivative calls receive up/down densities. The grho-to-grh transpose matches the differing native APIs. Reset restores the H0 GGA density cutoff 1e-6 and gradient cutoff 1e-10 before each call. dgcxc then changes internal GGA cutoffs to 1e-10; the second xc_gcx evaluation and the separate setup_dgc total-density >1e-6 condition reproduce dvxc_s. Original finite-difference drivers retain their own additional thresholds and steps. First-derivative potentials/flux receive e2 once; dmuxc and GGA derivative tensors already carry Ry and receive no second conversion. Negative/near-zero-density handling is delegated to those original routines rather than silently repaired.

execution_evidence.observed: All recorded compiler/link commands returned zero with zero stderr bytes. Private BEEF PIC adjunct and hidden/internal-symbol linking are explicitly disclosed in backend-link-amendment-001.json; the PBE archive remains unchanged.

accepted_evidence.claim: Physical-grid reconstruction preserves the original density/spin representation, Fourier normalization, local ionic constant and distinct Hartree zero mode.
accepted_evidence.details: Miller columns map modulo the physical shape in Fortran order. Forward FFTs are normalized and inverse FFTs reconstruct amplitudes; saved reciprocal vectors already have inverse-bohr units. Ionic coefficients retain the carried radial local G0 and structure factors, while Hartree alone omits G0 and uses total density identically in both spin channels. Full XC is local_xc minus the physical divergence. The local radial volume normalization is already included; there is no additional cell-volume or spin multiplier. Raw offsets are retained, with no fitted shift.

execution_evidence.observed: The executed report passes every coefficient comparison as well as the density, gradient and vrs comparisons. Recorded wrong ionic G0, Hartree G0, extra tpiba, Ry/Ha, spin-basis and divergence constructions separate above their registered allowances. These are existing executed results, not computations performed by this reviewer.

accepted_evidence.claim: New material Kq and the original guarded fixture caller consume every generated coefficient with the original complex-q algebra.
accepted_evidence.details: q is a real physical wavevector and the response envelopes are complex up/down fields. Both gradient and divergence use i(G+q), without conjugating the response gradient. All mixed-spin a/b/c contractions, negative divergence and the dimensionless |G+q|^2/tpiba^2 >1e-8 Coulomb admission are preserved. The final XC field is not truncated to the density G support. lrpa and lnolr remain forwarded by the old caller, and its existing fixture/schema guards are unchanged. The pair convention remains omega/N times the conjugate density-potential sum, with no extra spin factor.

execution_evidence.observed: All recorded Gamma and both signed nonzero-q comparisons pass. The preserved fixture-caller allowance is the original 1e-9*max(1,reference_max), not the new reconstruction allowance. For example gamma_Kprobe_0 reports 8.604777988911347e-13 Ry error and gamma_fixture_caller_Kprobe_0 reports 4.4226944273466224e-18 Ry error. The old original0016 source uses the same fixture allowance.

accepted_evidence.claim: The Hamiltonian is a full-PW block action with ordinary-NC beta D beta-dagger, rather than a saved-band closure or dense PW-square operator.
accepted_evidence.details: Kinetic energies are physical |k+G| squared in Ry. Local multiplication gathers back to unchanged PW rows. The BLAS overlap explicitly conjugate-transposes beta, atom-major channel blocks are weighted by the active per-species D, and the result is multiplied by beta without another normalization. The carried projector normalization already contains 4*pi/sqrt(omega), (-i)^l and the atomic exp[-i(k+G).tau] phase. Reuse across spins is admitted only after exact k/PW/basis matching. No saved occupations enter the operator.

accepted_evidence.claim: The material eigenpair residuals are preserved diagnostics of the output-density operator, not a new convergence gate or an automatically stationary reference.
accepted_evidence.interpretation: Original QE first diagonalizes the input-density Hamiltonian, forms the new density, and on convergence rebuilds the output HXC potential. Thus matching saved eigenvalues and vectors exactly is not the definition of the newly reconstructed output-density H0. The reported maxima alone do not identify which effect dominates a particular band, establish an observable error budget, or certify stationarity; no such numerical attribution is made. No tighter all-band residual threshold, energy shift, clipping, Hermitization or vector repair is requested. A later spectral-response consumer must address its own reference and observable accuracy rather than treat these saved eigenvalue labels as an exact spectrum.

qualifications: All numerical values in this report are quoted from existing executed oracle/output receipts; this reviewer ran no numerical computation, build, test, lint, formatter, SCF/PH producer or Git mutation.

The packet and source-access inventories supply settled source/output byte bindings. This review read them and the original sources; it did not recompute every existing binding or attest the whole OS, resident process state or hostile concurrent replacement.

The exact-backend claim means use of the original internal PBE implementation and its Native threshold/finite-difference conventions. It is not an assertion of an analytic exact Hessian or universal numerical identity for arbitrary unsupported setups.
Actual material coverage remains selected Gamma. Original nonzero-q fixture evidence validates that algebraic path but does not admit nonzero-q material response or complete BvK/star coverage.

The actual scope is full-complex collinear ordinary NC without NLCC, equal dense/smooth physical grids and ordinary periodic Coulomb. No noncollinear, SOC, PAW/USPP, core-correction, hybrid, meta-GGA or alternative electrostatic extension is accepted here.

Raw MV occupations, smearing width, saved eigenvalues and k weights retain their original labels. They are not physical probabilities, temperature, a calibrated stationary density or a physical preparation.

The state-independent force/density factor outputs do not choose D or imply electronic, ionic, cross or total material noise. The explicitly empty-complement quasifree family remains a declared family, not an established material state.
Stored-array restoration and one live restored K action establish completed-array/API reuse only, not interrupted-operation continuation, process/service crash recovery or Native history recovery.

The packet retains the missed timing targets, terminal-view timeout and absence of measured post-completion peak counters. They are not reinterpreted here as scientific failures or erased from the campaign history.
No stationary material, full spatial dynamics, thermal FDT, damping, bath calibration, coherence domain, nuclear bridge, PR readiness or whole-campaign completion follows from this scoped acceptance.
